allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "--- where.exe claude ---"; where.exe claude 2>&1; Write-Output "--- npm prefix ---"; npm config get prefix 2>&1; Write-Output "--- check common paths ---"; @\("$env:APPDATA\\npm\\claude.cmd", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\AnthropicClaude\\claude.exe", "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\local\\claude.exe"\) | ForEach-Object { if \(Test-Path $_\) { Write-Output "FOUND: $_" } else { Write-Output "missing: $_" } })

PowerShell(Write-Output "--- winget available? ---"; \(Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; Write-Output "--- node already installed? ---"; \(Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; Write-Output "--- npm already installed? ---"; \(Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source)

PowerShell($env:PATH = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('PATH','Machine'\) + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('PATH','User'\); Write-Output "--- node version ---"; node --version; Write-Output "--- npm version ---"; npm --version)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5100/api/auth/login" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"userId":"admin","password":"__wrong__"}' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 } catch { $r = $_.Exception.Response }; if \($r -is [System.Net.HttpWebResponse]\) { "Status: $\([int]$r.StatusCode\)"; \(New-Object IO.StreamReader\($r.GetResponseStream\(\)\)\).ReadToEnd\(\) } else { "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content })
